notes.title: Zombie BIG Update
notes.content:
Zombie Pinball Big Update is now live !

[h1][b]Additions[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Localization is now available for French, Italian, Spanish, German. Language is set based on your OS language and is English by default
    [*]Alt+F4 is now working
[/list] 

[h1][b]Gameplay Tweaks[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Score nerf. Score is now divided by 10 to avoid Steam Leaderboard issues. Leaderboards are therefore reinitialized
    [*]Needed score to reach for relevant Bloody Challenges is divided by 10 too
    [*]Bloody Star earning ratio is now 2 for 10 000 points instead of 1 for 100 000
    [*]A structual change of game save file force us to reset them
    [*]Added save if Retry from GameOver screen
[/list] 

[h1][b]BugFixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed All known issues about balls out of table
    [*]Fixed constant loading cursor
[/list] 

[h1][b]Known issues[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Alt+Tab crash is fixed but another one can still appear with bad luck
[/list] 

[h1][b]Note[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Master Player achievement will be a bit harder due to the nerf of the score. But it's still widely possible
[/list] 


Enjoy your Pinball games !
